company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech serving exporters with business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance. Its culture is commercially driven, with employees describing colleagues as friendly, though reviews suggest onboarding and training can vary between teams.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and helping across teams, taking responsibility and learning from mistakes, and simplifying work so it can move quickly for clients. Halden Pay offers career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring. Most offices use a hybrid model, typically with three days a week in the office, and the company supports connection through team events across its roughly 40 offices.

work_context.location_limits: Lisbon, Portugal; 3 days per week in the office. The ad specifies a central Lisbon office. No other location, time-zone, or work-authorization limits are stated.
culture_signals: The company describes its values as Together, Ownership, and Pace: sharing context and helping across teams; taking responsibility, fixing problems, and learning from them; and reducing unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients.
The company describes its environment as collaborative, with teamwork and personal development prioritized; it also mentions team events and regular get-togethers.
Reviews describe a commercially driven culture with friendly colleagues. Some reviewers say onboarding and training vary considerably between teams.
work_context.notes: The ad and company pages both state hybrid work with three days per week in the office; the ad specifies the central Lisbon office for this role. Review comments about onboarding and training are company-wide and do not establish what this role’s team provides.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
